name: DataFlow Evolve
description: Recursively evolves a data-processing pipeline over a fixed structured corpus. A coding agent proposes executable Python operators from the current best-so-far pipeline; the framework executes them and a candidate evaluator scores the output. Text tasks use ReviewAgent, while image/video/mixed tasks inject their own evaluator and operators. A better passing challenger replaces the incumbent. Rejected pipelines remain as condensed history, but their code is not inherited. Optional downstream diagnostics inform the next proposal without entering the acceptance score.
feedback_signal: Text tasks use ReviewAgent. The default rubric is a weighted correctness/relevance/difficulty/schema composite; a domain task may select criteria mode to replace that sample-level rubric with task.quality_criteria and return criterion evidence in domain_feedback. Optional DAS, normalized Vendi, and nearest-neighbor spread can be enabled independently under review.embedding_quality.metrics; their weighted embedding score is blended into review_score by review.embedding_quality.review_score_weight. Duplicate, null, contamination, and parse-valid rates remain deterministic hard checks. Image/video/mixed tasks require a task-owned evaluator returning a comparable score in [0,1], a passed gate, and optional domain feedback. Best-so-far compares (passed, candidate score). PipelineDiagnosticAgent and periodic downstream diagnostics are excluded from that comparison.
stopping_rule: Fixed iteration budget (max_iterations, 5 in the reference configuration). No convergence or early-stopping criterion. Per iteration the coding agent gets max_turns 50, a wall-clock timeout, and up to execution_repairs additional repair attempts after an artifact-validation, compile, execution, or output-validation failure; exhausting them fails that iteration without ending the run. The final incumbent is selected best-so-far: passing candidates first, then highest review_score.
migration_status: The evolution controller, review and diagnostic agents, execution wrapper, provider runtimes, configuration and skills live under rsi/framework. Generated operators use the framework's operator, pipeline and storage contracts. Text review is available; image/video/mixed tasks require a task-owned evaluator. Policy and Video domain algorithms remain source-only and are not yet integrated.
source_ref: Derived from the DataFlow-Evolver research prototype at commit ba6e489524bbf5835a06cccad555c5182e4ce4f4, whose source is retained read-only under rsi/methods/dataflow-evolver/.
